description: This file is a C header file defining the interface for vendor-specific functions, with function prototypes related to initialization, start, stop, and optional factory reset parameters.

methods.name: VENDOR_Init
methods.description: Prototype for initializing the vendor-specific subsystem.

methods.name: VENDOR_Start
methods.description: Prototype for starting the vendor-specific subsystem.

methods.name: VENDOR_Stop
methods.description: Prototype for stopping the vendor-specific subsystem.

methods.name: VENDOR_GetFactoryResetParams
methods.description: Prototype for retrieving factory reset parameters, included if INCLUDE_PROGRAMMATIC_FACTORY_RESET is defined.
